edit_device.title: Device capabilities
edit_device.description:
Configure "{device_name}".

Power is always enabled and cannot be disabled.

device_advanced.title: Advanced settings
device_advanced.description:
Overrides for "{device_name}".

- Capabilities (multi-select): all selected by default = everything enabled (including capabilities added later); clear a box to narrow what is exposed; power is always enabled.
- Hidden entities: selected entities are not exposed to Xiaodu (role detection / aggregation / leftovers all skip them).
- Build shape: force this device to build as a single split device or as a specific device type; falls back to split when the forced shape produces nothing.
- Role bindings: bind a semantic role to a specific entity (choose "auto-detect" for no binding).
- Device names: override the display name of an individual Xiaodu device without touching the Home Assistant entity name.
